source_text.docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolv: docs/issues/ISS-NNNN.yaml: status: <resolved | instrumented | no_defect>, plus THAT status's own key pair and its own required evidence. resolved uses resolved_in_run:/resolved_at:. If github_issue is set and gh is reachable: gh issue close <n> --comment "Fixed in <run-id>. See docs/issues/ISS-NNNN.yaml and the regression test at <test file path>." Never claim a fix or cite a regression test on a non-resolved close.
